scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB,WORKER "npm run dev --workspace @docklane/api" "npm run dev --workspace @docklane/web" "npm run dev --workspace @docklane/worker"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @docklane/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @docklane/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @docklane/api
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @docklane/api && npm run build --workspace @docklane/web && npm run build --workspace @docklane/worker
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @docklane/contracts && npm run build --workspace @docklane/database && npm run build --workspace @docklane/domain
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @docklane/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @docklane/web && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @docklane/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @docklane/web && eslint apps/api/src apps/worker/src packages tests scripts
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:test:migrate && vitest run --project api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run db:generate && npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @docklane/worker
